visual_action: A montage of four short clips showing Speaker Mike Johnson in various settings within a government building. He is seen walking into a room, standing at a podium as a woman walks by, speaking to people in a hallway, and sitting at a desk addressing an audience.

cast.name: Mike Johnson
cast.evidence: He is visually present in every clip of the montage and is named in the on-screen text: 'day 36 of mike johnson not doing his job...'

cast.name: Adelita Grijalva
cast.evidence: She is named in the on-screen text as the person Mike Johnson is allegedly refusing to inaugurate: '...refusing to swear in adelita grijalva'.

on_screen_text.text: day 36 of mike johnson not doing his job and refusing to swear in adelita grijalva

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; the only audio is instrumental music.
audio_music: A slow, somber, and slightly ominous piano track plays throughout the video. The music is identified as being from the horror game 'Granny', which creates a tense and critical tone.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced montage consisting of four separate clips with simple cuts between them.
cultural_references: The background music is from the horror video game 'Granny'.
central_claim: Mike Johnson is neglecting his duties as Speaker of the House by refusing to swear in Adelita Grijalva for over a month.
intended_effect: To portray Mike Johnson as derelict in his duties and generate criticism of his leadership.
